Goal GOAL_RESILIENT_EXECUTION (Recover from transient execution failures without unbounded work)
Feature FEAT_PROVIDER_RETRY (Provider retry)
Requirement REQ_PROVIDER_RETRY (Retry only temporary provider failures): Temporary provider failures shall be eligible for retry, while permanent failures shall not be retried as if they were transient.
Technical requirement TREQ_PROVIDER_RETRY_BOUNDS (Same-route provider retry is bounded): For one resolved provider route, provider execution shall perform no more than the configured retry maximum-attempt count before surfacing the final failure to routing. The initial provider call counts as attempt one, and every wait before a retry shall last at least the configured minimum retry wait and no longer than the configured maximum retry wait.

structured.finding: No requirement says that each scheduled same-route retry must log a `retry.scheduled` event and send its retry state to `state_sink`. An observability requirement should say that every retry wait is reported, with its attempt number and wait.
structured.reason: Dropping `before_sleep` does not change the attempt count, which exceptions are retried, or the wait bounds, so TREQ_PROVIDER_RETRY_BOUNDS still holds. What changes is something callers and operators can see: the `llm_router.provider.retry.scheduled` event is no longer emitted and `state_sink` never gets the retry state. No requirement shown here says either must happen.
